تكاتفت (form VI)

# تَكَاتَفْتَ (takātafta) /ta.kaː.taf.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَاتَفَ (takātafa)
# تَكَاتَفْتِ (takātafti) /ta.kaː.taf.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَاتَفَ (takātafa)
# تَكَاتَفَتْ (takātafat) /ta.kaː.ta.fat/: third-person fem
